detail-navigation: Detail views offer next and previous navigation plus swipe between items. Demonstrate both controls and the swipe transition, not just a static detail screen.
instant-state: Every send or answer immediately shows a pending, sent, answered or error state. Demonstrate the action and its immediate feedback; a final reply alone does not prove timing.
destructive-undo: Destructive actions offer undo. Demonstrate the action, visible undo and restored content after undo.
scroll-restoration: Lists preserve scroll position on returning from a detail view. Demonstrate the scrolled list, opening a detail and returning to the same position.
list-search: Long lists have usable search or filtering. Demonstrate the long list and the changed results after searching or filtering.
empty-next-step: Empty states explain the next step a user can take. Show the real empty state with its actionable explanation.
